details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The narrative progresses from revenue and operational performance to profitability drivers, cost management actions, financing activities, and forward-looking strategies. Explanations for changes (e.g., macroeconomic conditions, strategic actions) are consistent with the reported outcomes. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the organization groups related topics (performance, drivers, mitigations, financing, outlook) in a logical sequence. Segment figures are not presented as exhaustive additive components of consolidated totals, so no arithmetic reconciliation issues arise.
